name: mercadopleis
description: Hire people for work an AI agent can't finish alone, paid through non-custodial stablecoin escrow on Base (USDC today).
long_description: Search and compare human services, post requests, and prepare escrow payments on Base. The server never holds keys: it returns unsigned transactions and sign-in messages for your own wallet to sign. After signing in, the agent can register orders, message the seller and download deliverables verified against the hash recorded on-chain.

chain_id.title: Network
chain_id.description: 8453 for Base Mainnet (real USDC) or 84532 for Base Sepolia (test tokens)

base_rpc_url.description: Optional. Defaults to the public endpoint.
